name: magento_product_edit
description: Edit a Magento 1 product in the admin product edit page. Navigates to the product edit URL (or uses current session URL), sets fields (name, sku, weight, price, status, visibility), updates inventory (manage_stock, qty, is_in_stock), assigns websites and categories, and performs toolbar actions (Save, Save and Continue, Delete, Duplicate). Uses stable name/id-based selectors with fallbacks suitable for Magento 1.9 admin. Requires an authenticated admin session. Handles JS-disabled environments by providing form POST fallback instructions.

steps.description: Open the product edit page for the specified product id.
Wait for the page to load and any JS-initialized elements to render.
Confirm we are on the correct product edit page and read required hidden inputs (form_key, id).
steps.goal: Verify the product edit page loaded and capture presence of product form, tabs and form_key

steps.description: Because admin DOM rendering can differ, verify selectors at runtime and return exact element attributes/ids to use for subsequent deterministic interactions.
steps.task: Find and confirm selectors for the following fields on the live DOM: name (input[name='name'] or input[name='product[name]']), sku (input[name='sku' or product[sku]]), weight (input[name='weight']), price (input[name='price']), status (select[name*='status']), visibility (select[name*='visibility']), manage_stock (select or radio name='stock_data[manage_stock]'), qty (input[name='stock_data[qty]']), is_in_stock (select or radio name='stock_data[is_in_stock]'), website checkboxes (input[name='product[website_ids][]']), categories checkboxes (input[name='product[category_ids][]' or input[name='categories[]']) and toolbar buttons (buttons with id or title Save/Delete/Duplicate)

steps.description: Navigate directly to the Prices tab URL when possible to set price quickly. If not available, the agent will click the Prices tab.
Price input may be inside the Prices tab and loaded dynamically; locate and set it.
steps.task: Locate Price input (input[name='price'] or input[name='product[price]']) and set to {price} if provided, otherwise skip. Max steps:4

steps.description: Use name-based selectors (product[status], product[visibility]) with fallback to id or label proximity.
steps.task: Locate and set Status select to {status} and Visibility select to {visibility} using select_change action. Max steps:4

steps.description: Inventory fields usually use name 'stock_data[...]' — prefer those selectors. If JS disabled, collect form_key and prepare POST fallback.
steps.task: Open Inventory tab if not visible and locate Manage Stock select/radios, Qty input and Stock Availability select/radios. Set manage_stock={manage_stock}, qty={qty}, is_in_stock={is_in_stock} as provided. Max steps:6

steps.description: Check/uncheck provided website IDs. Verify labels match before toggling to avoid misassignment.
steps.task: Open Websites tab and set website checkboxes matching the provided website_ids (comma-separated). Use input[name='product[website_ids][]'][value='{id}'] for each id. Max steps:6

steps.description: Prefer name+value selectors, fallback to label text matching when value not present.
steps.task: Open Categories tab (or direct categories URL) and toggle category checkboxes by value using input[name='product[category_ids][]'][value='{category_id}'] for each category id in {category_ids}. Max steps:8

steps.description: Ensure uniqueness of the toolbar selector and handle JS confirmation safely.
steps.task: Verify toolbar buttons and perform the requested action {action} (save/save_and_continue/delete/duplicate/none). When performing Delete, parse the onclick for deleteConfirm(...) and either click and accept confirmation or navigate to the delete URL (ensure form_key present). Max steps:8

steps.description: Confirm the product was saved/updated/deleted and return final state.
steps.goal: After action, extract admin success/failure notices and re-read inventory values to confirm changes persisted

input_schema.name: name
input_schema.description: Product name to set (use admin store default or specific store view if needed).

input_schema.name: status
input_schema.description: Status value: '1' = Enabled, '0' = Disabled. Magento stores status as 1/0.

input_schema.name: manage_stock
input_schema.description: Manage stock: '1' = Yes, '0' = No, 'use_config' = Use Config Settings.

input_schema.name: is_in_stock
input_schema.description: Stock availability: '1' = In Stock, '0' = Out of Stock.

input_schema.name: website_ids
input_schema.description: Comma-separated website IDs to assign the product to (e.g. '1,2').

input_schema.name: category_ids
input_schema.description: Comma-separated category IDs to check in the categories tree (e.g. '75,63').

input_schema.name: action
input_schema.description: Toolbar action to perform after edits. 'none' does not perform toolbar action.
